newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex moves ahead with planned BIS buy.
newsitem.headline: Vendex moves ahead with planned BIS buy.

text.p: Retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Wednesday it was moving ahead with its plans to buy French temporary employment agency BIS SA following EU approval of the deal on Friday.

Vendex said that following EU approval it had now implemented its agreement with the family of BIS founder Laurent Negro to buy their 59 percent controlling stake in BIS at a price of 490 French francs ($86.87) per share.
It said it would now proceed with its earlier announced bid at the same price for the remaining shares, listed on the Paris bourse, as soon as it had received permission from the bourse.
Official bid documents were expected to be published next week, it added.
Vendex first announced its planned 2.5 billion franc bid for BIS on January 6.
